data.title: Complete each sentence by choosing the correct word.
data.description: Practise the Past Simple tense at A1 level using regular and common irregular verbs.
learningPoints: Use the Past Simple to talk about finished actions in the past.
Regular verbs usually end in -ed in the Past Simple.
Many common verbs have irregular past forms such as went, saw and had.
Use did and didn't for Past Simple questions and negatives.
Learn to recognise common past time expressions such as yesterday, last week and ago.
Build confidence using the most common A1 past tense verbs.
Develop accurate speaking and writing about past events.
Supports CEFR A1 grammar for everyday communication.
